rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for saying that someone did something deliberately.

example.jyutping: nei5 dak6 dang1 m4 fuk1 ngo5 gaa3

rows.note: Use this when you want to foreground the person's intention, especially in contrast with doing something accidentally.

example.english: I didn't deliberately break the cup.
example.traditional: 我唔係故意整爛個杯㗎。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 hai6 gu3 ji3 zing2 laan6 go3 bui1 gaa3

rows.note: Use this for deliberately going out of one's way to do something, often with an implication of making a special trip or effort.

example.english: I deliberately went to Mong Kok to buy this book.
example.traditional: 我專登去旺角買呢本書。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zyun1 dang1 heoi3 wong6 gok3 maai5 ni1 bun2 syu1
